C19.file_specific_assessment: The structured callback comparison retains ordered observed inputs and output identities, aliases and run context. It carries no raw pointers, game source or complete exported game resource.
C19.attribution: Bethesda/ZeniMax game content and observed behavior; capture and analysis provenance as cited. Project licensing covers authored research and verifiers where the contributors have rights.
C19.local_retrieval: Use the D5BF-LOCAL-INPUTS receipt to retrieve the exact staged file by asset ID, basename and SHA-256.
C19.required_approval: Maintainer must freeze exact selection and claim routes for B6, separately authorize exact tag and draft upload after B6, and separately authorize visibility and timing after hosted-byte checks.
C19.release_association: Planned GitHub Release for research pinned to Starfield.exe 1.16.244.0; exact tag and release pending maintainer decision.
C19.producer: C19 project native observer and operator phase testimony; D5BE authored bounded operand extraction.
C19.version_qualification: Pinned retail baseline and original observer contract. Native row checks and A/B/C operator labels have separate provenance. Exact display timing and producer ancestry are unverified.
